Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up at Shanghai data center tied to Alice Huang

Two Chinese companies installed the chips, including a GB300 NVL72 rack, at the Yangtze River Delta Project. A serial number in documents filed with Chinese regulators in November identifies the rack. A Bloomberg investigation traced the serial number to Taiwanese manufacturer Gigabyte.

Reported by The Decoder; Bloomberg.
